title: Women's Floral – Wildly Low Maintenance Embroidered Zip Hoodie
who: the woman who is wildly low maintenance and keeps a bouquet on the table anyway, zipped on over a sundress at the farmers market and on the porch in the evening.
art: A loose wildflower bouquet of daisies, poppies and cornflowers tied with a cream ribbon, in sage, mustard, rust, cream and blue with a worn print texture.
headline: WILDLY LOW
inks: mustard and coral on Black and Navy, brown and navy on Ash
chest: a small wildflower with two leaves
warm2: cool market mornings, porch evenings and garden chores
gift_line: for the friend who never fusses and always brings flowers.
seo_desc: A floral zip up hoodie: WILDLY LOW MAINTENANCE on the back over a wildflower bouquet, plus an embroidered wildflower on the chest.
